name: Caterpillar Carriage

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia World Guide

items.name: Like Clockwork
items.text:
Trigger The caterpillar carriage gains the Slowed or Stunned condition

---

Effect The carriage is Quickened for 1 round.

items.name: Rescue
items.text: The caterpillar carriage absorbs a willing construct within its reach. That construct doesn't exist separately until the caterpillar carriage releases it as an Interact action or is destroyed.

items.name: Rock Tunneler
items.text: The caterpillar carriage can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does.

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Huge or Smaller, Wheel, DC 40 basic Reflex save

---

text:
The constructs of the Clicking Caverns all have similar designs, being made of clockwork. The most unusual feature of them is that they're self-replicating, or perhaps self-reincarnating, since the animation of a haunted construct requires a soul.

---
The haunted construct known as the caterpillar carriage is composed of armored segments that flow over one another as the carriage inches forward. It has two forelegs that dig grooves into the ground, making way for the many wheels situated along its underside.
